services.name: Termite contract & renewal
services.blurb: A yearly termite contract with a dated inspection log, so renewals show what was checked.

services.name: Formosan termite treatment
services.blurb: Treatment aimed at Formosan colonies, which can nest in walls and do not need soil contact.

services.name: Bait station monitoring
services.blurb: Numbered stations around the house checked on a schedule, with readings logged every visit.

services.name: Mosquito treatment
services.blurb: Monthly yard treatment from spring to first frost, aimed at shade and standing water.

services.name: Fire ants
services.blurb: Yard mounds treated and rechecked, with a note of where new ones keep popping up.

services.name: Roaches & palmetto bugs
services.blurb: Big outdoor roaches kept outside: entry points found, sealed and treated around the edge.

services.name: Rats in the attic
services.blurb: Roof rats trapped and their way in sealed, from soffit gaps to tree limbs on the roof.

services.name: Quarterly pest visits
services.blurb: Four logged visits a year, and a ticket that says what was used and where.

services.name: After-flood termite check
services.blurb: Wet framing and disturbed bait stations checked after high water, before termites move in.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The renewal came with a printed log of every station and every visit for the year. Station 7 by the AC pad had hits in May, and they showed me what they did about it.
reviews.name: Monica L.

reviews.text: Formosan swarmers around the porch light in May. Remy explained the difference between liquid and bait with prices for each, side by side. We went bait.
reviews.name: Andre T.

reviews.text: After the 2016 flood our house had water halfway up the walls. Years later, they still check the old wet framing on every visit. Nothing has turned up.
reviews.name: Brenda F.

reviews.text: Palmetto bugs were coming in under the back door. They sealed the threshold and the weep holes and treated the slab edge. I have seen one since, dead.
reviews.name: Corey J.

reviews.text: Mosquitoes made the backyard useless after six. Monthly treatment from April and we eat on the patio again. The ticket says what they sprayed each time.
reviews.name: Stacy N.

reviews.text: Heard scratching over the bedroom ceiling. Roof rats coming up the oak limb onto the roof. They trapped five, sealed the soffit and told me to cut the limb back.
reviews.name: Paul R.

reviews.text: Fire ant mounds all along the ditch by our driveway. Treated in March, rechecked in April, and the log shows the two new mounds they caught.
reviews.name: Dana W.

proof.guarantee: If termites show up in a treated area during your contract, we retreat at no charge.
